messages:
support-jess: Heads-up: ACME (dedicated) reports 403 on project console after rotating their dedicated API key. Customer says web UI blocked and API calls return 403. Repro steps pasted below. Escalating — need platform/SRE help.

eng-platform-raj: Can you paste the exact error payload and request-id? Any recent deploys that touched auth mapping?

support-jess: Error snippet:
```json
{"error":"PERMISSION_DENIED","code":403,"message":"project.view denied","request_id":"rQ9b-7z","actor":"service_account:acme-connector"}
```
Also they said they rotated key at 2026-03-17T10:02:00Z. Console login works for org admins but project editors/viewers get 403.

deploy-bot: rollout auth-mapper v2 completed at 2026-03-17T09:58:00Z (canary->global) :information_source: 

eng-sre-maya: :thinking_face: That rollout touched group->role mapping service. Suspect mapping normalization trimmed a `project.viewer` mapping for tokens scoped to `dedicated:read`.

eng-platform-raj: Try a targeted resync for that project. Command:
```bash
redwood-admin auth resync --project acme-prod --request-id rQ9b-7z --force
```
Also gather audit logs: `auth-mapper.log` entries around 09:58.

support-jess: Ran resync, can confirm web console access restored for one test user, but customer's CI still gets 403 for API calls.

eng-sre-maya: CI likely using token with `scope=dedicated:read` which our mapping service no longer recognizes as `project.viewer`. We need a hotfix to mapping fallback and then resync tokens.

eng-platform-raj: I can patch mapper to accept legacy scopes. Plan: rollback normalization for legacy scope parsing and deploy patch to mapper (hotfix). I'll schedule a small window and run resync.

security-ops: Please add the exact request_ids and keep audit logs. We need to ensure no privilege escalation during hotfix. Also confirm customer service account only gains viewer perms (no admin).

eng-platform-raj: Patch applied to auth-mapper at 2026-03-17T10:15Z. Then ran `redwood-admin auth resync --project acme-prod --force --target=service_account:acme-connector`

sre-bot: Alert: auth-mapper errors decreased from 240->3 in last 10m. :white_check_mark:

support-jess: Customer confirms: CI tokens now allowed, console access stable. They asked what caused it for post-mortem.

eng-sre-maya: Root cause: aggressive normalization in auth-mapper v2 dropped legacy scope alias `dedicated:read` for service-account tokens during mapping creation. Fix: reintroduce alias table + add integration test.

eng-platform-raj: I'll open a PR for tests and schedule canary validation. Also will add a monitoring alert for mapping-drop-rate > 1%.

support-jess: Customer happy, closing the escalation. Will attach timeline and notes to the ticket.
